title: The Secret of Tremendous Corporation
reason: Approved for production hosting after exact ScummVM Version 6 package audit and source-backed rights review. The authors' official itch.io release declares LGPL-3.0 for code and CC-BY-SA-4.0 for assets; the author-linked Steam-tag source is pinned and preserved with its CC-BY-SA-4.0 COPYING file. The exact ScummVM package contains a separate permissive Google/BSD-style third-party notice which is preserved but is not treated as the whole-game license.
